purpose: Define the hard boundary between non-executable command-family namespaces and executable concrete commands throughout the recursive command tree.

does_not_own: domain semantics outside explicit command targets

value.namespace_rule: A command-family node groups descendants and may carry metadata/help without being executable.
value.executable_rule: Only nodes explicitly declared as executable commands may dispatch.
value.mixed_rule: A node may be both namespace and executable only when both semantics are explicitly declared.
value.listing_rule: Family invocation without executable semantics returns help/listing/error according to explicit command UX policy, never an inferred descendant.
value.descendant_rule: Concrete descendant identity includes the full namespace path.
value.authority_rule: Namespace membership does not broaden descendant command authority.
value.example_rule: export is a family namespace; concrete executable descendants may include export.code, export.file, export.json or deeper families such as export.files.json where defined.
